Each page here takes one lab and answers "what goes in this part for this lab?" for all three jobs. The format itself, what belongs on which whiteboard and where the photos go, is on [How a Lab Gets Turned In](../02-lab-report-format.qmd); these pages assume you have read it. The two uncertainty rows at the bottom of every data table are covered in the [uncertainty guide](../01-uncertainty.qmd).

The pages go up as the semester goes on, usually a few days before the lab. If the one you need is not here yet, the lab handout and the format page between them cover everything.

::: {#guides}
